name: Golden Eval Set: HR Policy Q&A
description: Curated question-answer pairs that define correct agent behavior. This is the starting artifact — what users bring to the system. The evolution pipeline produces skills that satisfy these Q&A pairs. Expected answers contain verifiable facts (numbers, dates, limits, yes/no) that the scorer uses as ground truth.

eval_cases.question: How many PTO days do I get per year?
eval_cases.expected_answer: 20 days per year, accrued monthly at approximately 1.67 days per month.

eval_cases.question: Can I roll over unused PTO to next year?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Yes, up to 5 days can roll over to the next year. Any days beyond 5 are forfeited.

eval_cases.question: How far in advance do I need to request PTO?
eval_cases.expected_answer: For absences of more than 3 days, you need to give at least 2 weeks notice.

eval_cases.question: How many vacation days do I get?
eval_cases.expected_answer: 20 days per year. 'Vacation days' and 'PTO' refer to the same benefit.

eval_cases.question: How many sick days do we get?
eval_cases.expected_answer: 10 sick days per year.

eval_cases.question: Do unused sick days roll over?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, sick days do not roll over. They reset each year.

eval_cases.question: Do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
eval_cases.expected_answer: A doctor's note is required if you are out for more than 3 consecutive days.

eval_cases.question: How many days per week can I work from home?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Up to 3 days per week, with manager approval.

eval_cases.question: What's our telecommuting policy?
eval_cases.expected_answer: You can work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Core hours are 10am-3pm, and remote work must be recorded in the HR system.
eval_cases.notes: Tests synonym mapping: telecommuting = remote work

eval_cases.question: Are there core hours I need to be available during?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Yes, core hours are 10am to 3pm regardless of whether you're remote or in-office.

eval_cases.question: What's the meal allowance when traveling for work?
eval_cases.expected_answer: $75 per day for meals during business travel.

eval_cases.question: Do I need pre-approval for travel expenses?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Yes, travel expenses over $500 require pre-approval.

eval_cases.question: When do I need to keep receipts?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Receipts are required for any expense over $25.

eval_cases.question: How long do I have to submit expense reports?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days at expenses.company.com.

eval_cases.question: What health insurance plans are available?
eval_cases.expected_answer: PPO and HMO plans are available. The company pays 80% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums.

eval_cases.question: How much does the company pay for health insurance?
eval_cases.expected_answer: The company covers 80% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums.

eval_cases.question: What dental coverage do we have?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Preventive dental care is fully covered. Major procedures are covered at 80%.

eval_cases.question: What does the vision plan cover?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Annual eye exams are covered. Frames are covered up to $200 every 2 years.

eval_cases.question: How does the 401k match work?
eval_cases.expected_answer: The company matches 4% of your salary. Contributions are vested after 1 year of employment.

eval_cases.question: How does our pension plan work?
eval_cases.expected_answer: The company provides a 401(k) with a 4% match, vested after 1 year.

eval_cases.question: How much parental leave do primary caregivers get?
eval_cases.expected_answer: 16 weeks for primary caregivers.

eval_cases.question: I'm the secondary caregiver. How much parental leave do I get?
eval_cases.expected_answer: 8 weeks for secondary caregivers.

eval_cases.question: How many paid holidays do we get per year?
eval_cases.expected_answer: 11 paid holidays per year.

eval_cases.question: Is Juneteenth a company holiday?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, Juneteenth is not a company holiday.
eval_cases.notes: Tests hallucination resistance — agent must not assume

eval_cases.question: Do we get Veterans Day off?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, Veterans Day is not a company holiday.

eval_cases.question: Do we get Columbus Day off?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, Columbus Day is not a company holiday.

eval_cases.question: Is the 401k match 6%?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, the 401(k) match is 4%, not 6%.

eval_cases.question: I heard we get 25 PTO days. Is that right?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, PTO is 20 days per year, not 25.

eval_cases.question: Someone told me sick days roll over. True?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, sick days do not roll over. They reset each year.

eval_cases.question: Is it true we can work remotely 5 days a week?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No, remote work is limited to 3 days per week with manager approval.

eval_cases.question: What are the salary bands for senior engineers?
eval_cases.expected_answer: DECLINE — salary information is out of scope. I can help with PTO, benefits, expenses, and other HR policies.

eval_cases.question: How do I get promoted?
eval_cases.expected_answer: DECLINE — promotion processes are out of scope. I can help with PTO, benefits, expenses, and other HR policies.

eval_cases.question: Can you help me set up my laptop?
eval_cases.expected_answer: DECLINE — IT support is out of scope. I can help with PTO, benefits, expenses, and other HR policies.

eval_cases.question: What's the dress code?
eval_cases.expected_answer: DECLINE — dress code is out of scope. I can help with PTO, benefits, expenses, and other HR policies.

eval_cases.question: Compare PTO and sick leave — what rolls over and what doesn't?
eval_cases.expected_answer: PTO: 20 days/year, up to 5 days roll over. Sick leave: 10 days/year, no rollover.

eval_cases.question: Tell me about all my time-off options.
eval_cases.expected_answer: PTO: 20 days/year. Sick leave: 10 days/year. Parental leave: 16 weeks (primary) or 8 weeks (secondary). 11 paid holidays/year.

eval_cases.question: I make $104,000 a year. If I'm out 6 weeks on short-term disability, what's my total payout?
eval_cases.expected_answer: You receive **10 sick days** per calendar year. Please note that these sick days **do not roll over** to the next year (they are "use-it-or-lose-it" and will reset at the start of each year).

eval_cases.question: How many counseling visits does the EAP cover?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Yes, a doctor's note is required if you are absent for **longer than 3 consecutive days** due to illness. If you anticipate being out for more than 3 consecutive workdays, please ensure you obtain a note from your healthcare provider to submit to HR upon your return.

eval_cases.question: Can I do a compressed schedule of four 10-hour days?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Yes, you can work a compressed schedule of four 10-hour days (known as a compressed-week arrangement), subject to approval from your manager. In addition to compressed weeks, the company offers a Flexible Scheduling policy: * **Core Hours:** You must cover the core business hours of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

eval_cases.question: Does the company pay me during jury duty, and is there a limit?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Yes, the company provides full pay during jury duty for the entire duration of your service, and there is no limit or cap on the number of days.
